feature-list-dynamic.label: Our Programs
feature-list-dynamic.title: Explore Career-Focused Courses at LCC Campus
feature-list-dynamic.description: We offer a range of professional courses in accounting, multimedia, and digital skills to prepare you for real-world success.

features.title: Diploma in Computerized Industrial Accounting (DCIA)
features.description: One-year program covering financial accounting, taxation, payroll, GST, and Tally/Excel for finance careers.

features.title: Advanced Diploma in Accounts & Financial Marketing
features.description: Blend advanced accounting with marketing strategies, financial analysis, and digital tools for business development roles.

features.title: Diploma in Indian & Foreign Accounting
features.description: Six-month practical training in Indian and international accounting systems, GST, income tax, and global standards.

features.title: Diploma in Financial Accounting
features.description: Three-month course covering bookkeeping, GST, taxation, and Tally/Excel for entry-level accounting positions.

features.title: Advanced Diploma in Multimedia & Animation (ADMA)
features.description: 18-month creative program in graphic design, 2D/3D animation, VFX, video editing, and multimedia production.

features.title: Digital Graphics Course
features.description: Eight-month course on image editing, illustration, typography, and design workflows using Photoshop and Illustrator.

about-brief-dynamic.title: About LCC Campus
about-brief-dynamic.description1: LCC Campus offers a diverse range of professional courses in accounting, multimedia, design, IT, and vocational training, equipping students with industry-ready skills for successful careers.
about-brief-dynamic.description2: Located in Kerala, our institution is dedicated to providing practical, career-focused education that prepares students for the demands of the modern workforce.
